title: Sr Desenvolvedor Back-end (Java)
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;

  • Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js + NestJS;
  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;
  • Experiência com Design de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com Testes Unitários (jUnit 5) e Testes Contrato (Pact);
  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;
  • Experiência com em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA tools specialist)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA/Broadcom tols) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Experience with CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Experience with CA FAVER, CA Allocate (installation, configuration, training).
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Experience with IBM storage tools .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga


Evoluir as práticas, ferramentas e habilidades de administração de vendas e gestão de contas para aprimorar o atendimento das expectativas dos nossos clientes e expandir em novos negócios


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de negócios na prospecção, qualificação e fechamento de oportunidades de vendas, identificando necessidades, prazos e orçamento para a venda de produtos e/ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e utilizando o CRM na gestão das contas nomeadas e oportunidades em cada fase do processo de venda, visando atingir as metas estabelecidas;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para venda de produtos e serviços em soluções departamentais e/ou corporativas, negociando as condições das propostas para a efetivação da venda e analisando condições técnicas e comerciais de contratos de prestação de serviços com base na orientação da área de Contratos;
  • Estruturar proposta técnica com apoio do arquiteto, entendendo os requisitos do cliente, identificando e estruturando soluções de negócios que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e compondo preços de vendas de produtos/soluções e serviços;
  • Formular termos de referências e propostas comerciais, utilizando como referência modelos existentes e contando com apoio (Gestão, Executivo, Arquiteto, Gerente de Negócios ou Analista de Negócios);
  • Realizar apresentações executivas de produtos/soluções e serviços para clientes.
  • Criar estratégias de posicionamento dos produtos/soluções da Imagem nos clientes, mapeando perfis de cliente e identificando influenciadores, decisores, agentes externos e concorrentes;
  • Interagir com as todas as áreas promovendo o alinhamento de ideias e práticas em relação aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas; Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado.


Habilidades Desejáveis:


  • Microsoft Office;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções para Governo;


Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Pharmaceutical Retailers and Distributors (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specializing in business, healthcare, and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association, and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking for professionals in large pharmacy retailers and distributors for a paid consultancy section.


Qualifications:

  • Responsible for purchasing, procurement, or supply chain decisions within Consumer Healthcare retail and wholesale organizations
  • The purpose of this study is to understand the evolving landscape of trust, regulation, and reputation within the healthcare industry.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online survey , lasting around 20 minutes.


Compensation package - BRL R$750 for 20 minutes online survey

title: Governanta
description:
VAGA: GOVERNANTA RESIDENCIAL – ALTO PADRÃO

Residência de alto padrão busca Governanta Residencial  para atuação estratégica e operacional, com foco em organização, gestão da rotina doméstica e excelência no padrão de entrega.

 Sobre a função

A governanta será responsável por garantir o perfeito funcionamento da casa no dia a dia, atuando como elo entre família, funcionárias e fornecedores. Espera-se postura profissional, visão de hotelaria aplicada à residência e capacidade de antecipar necessidades.

 Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão da rotina doméstica e acompanhamento das atividades diárias
  • Organização e manutenção do padrão da casa
  • Coordenação e supervisão de funcionárias (babás, faxineiras e demais prestadores)
  • Controle de cronogramas, enxoval, materiais e insumos
  • Interface direta com os proprietários
  • Garantia de discrição, confidencialidade e excelência no atendimento

 Perfil desejado

  • Experiência comprovada como governanta residencial
  • Postura ética, discreta e extremamente profissional
  • Organização, liderança e senso de prioridade
  • Comunicação clara e respeitosa
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alto nível de exigência e padrão
  • Vivência em casas de alto padrão será um diferencial

 Requisitos

  • Referências profissionais comprovadas
  • Disponibilidade para dedicação integral
  • Comprometimento com padrões elevados de qualidade
  • Apresentação pessoal alinhada ao ambiente de luxo residencial

 Oferecemos

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado de alto padrão
  • Ambiente estruturado e profissional
  • Relação de trabalho clara, organizada e respeitosa

 Candidatura

Interessadas devem enviar currículo e breve apresentação profissional. Apenas candidatas dentro do perfil serão contatadas: .

title: [Vendas] Consultoria de vendas Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Ser referência para entender, demonstrar e validar os requisitos técnicos e comerciais de um determinado produto e/ou serviço TOTVS, a fim de apoiar os canais de distribuição na geração e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócios.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Ter bom conhecimento de um produto ou serviço TOTVS, de baixa complexidade, para realizar demonstrações e validações de requisitos técnicos;
  • Conhecer a política comercial e tabela de preço do produto ou serviço sob seu domínio para apoiar os canais de distribuição TOTVS em suas negociações;
  • Interagir com clientes e/ou prospects, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, por meio dos canais de distribuição TOTVS, para esclarecer suas dúvidas e propor soluções relacionadas ao produto sob seu domínio;
  • Preparar ambientes e sistemas, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, para a realização de demonstrações, eventos e webinars;
  • Demonstrar o produto ou serviço TOTVS sob seu domínio aos clientes e/ou prospects, através do cumprimento do checklist da apresentação, roteiro e processos estabelecidos pela área;
  • Apoiar, com alto nível de orientação e supervisão, na execução dos planos táticos de vendas dos canais de distribuição TOTVS;
  • Elaborar relatórios para ESNs e/ou Arquitetos dos projetos, apresentando os pontos relevantes de dúvidas e questionamentos do cliente através de ata da reunião.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação Completa


Conhecimentos:

  • Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Notes) - nível básico;
  • Pacote Google Workspace (Google Forms, Gmail, Drive, Google Sheets, etc.) - nível básico


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

#Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Mobile Developer (React Native / Expo)

12 Month +

200-275 USD per day

Remote Euro time zone


Contract | Fully Remote


We’re looking for a Mobile Developer to help build and scale consumer-facing mobile applications. This is a hands-on product role focused on delivering high-quality, performant cross-platform experiences for iOS and Android.

You’ll work closely with backend and product teams to ship features quickly while maintaining clean architecture and a smooth user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo
  • Develop new features with a strong focus on performance, usability, and code quality
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and product to scope, design, and implement functionality
  • Ensure high-quality releases through testing and debugging
  • Own deployments to App Store and Google Play
  • Continuously improve app architecture and user experience


Must Have

  • 3+ years professional experience building mobile applications
  • Strong experience with React Native and Expo
  • Proven experience shipping production apps for both iOS and Android
  • Solid JavaScript / TypeScript skills
  • Focus on performance, clean architecture, and UX
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Experience with React.js
  • Experience working closely with Node.js backend teams
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile apps

description:

The Office Coordinator will manage daily operations by providing administrative assistance, handling communications, and maintaining office systems and equipment. Additional responsibilities include managing schedules, responding to inquiries, assisting with customer service activities, and ensuring smooth internal processes across the organization.


Qualifications

  • Experience with Administrative Assistance and proficiency in handling Office Equipment
  • Strong Phone Etiquette and Customer Service skills
  • Excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficiency with office software and tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Prior experience in office coordination or similar roles is a plus

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: React Application Architect
description:
About You

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms. You enjoy designing scalable, privacy-compliant architectures that enable reliable data collection, attribution, and measurement across complex digital ecosystems. You take ownership of architectural decisions, think in systems, and balance technical rigor with business impact.

You are comfortable operating across marketing, analytics, and engineering teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear guidance, and defining standards that improve data quality, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture, marketing technology, or analytics engineering roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of React , JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to implement and debug complex tracking solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Tag Manager, including custom JavaScript variables and structured data layer implementations.
  • Strong experience implementing and governing Google Analytics 4, including event modeling and advanced tracking strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Facebook Business Manager, Facebook Pixel, and Conversions API.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking and remarketing integrations.
  • Proven experience designing client-side and server-side tracking architectures.
  • Strong understanding of privacy regulations, Consent Mode, and browser restrictions (ITP) and their impact on data collection.
  • Experience using browser developer tools and tag debugging extensions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement a modular, scalable application architecture for marketing data collection and digital analytics.
  • Own and optimize advanced Google Tag Manager configurations, including tags, triggers, variables, and structured data layers.
  • Govern tracking implementations across Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel, including Conversions API integrations.
  • Design tracking solutions resilient to browser privacy restrictions and compliant with global privacy regulations.
  • Lead the transition from fragmented client-side tracking to robust server-side and API-driven architectures when appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex, production-level tracking and performance issues affecting data accuracy or site stability.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure data accuracy, attribution integrity, and alignment with business and marketing objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to document requirements and implement new tracking solutions.
  • Optimize tracking implementations to protect and improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and architecture standards related to tracking, performance, and system reliability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture or marketing technology roles.
  • 5+ years of experience with React.
  • Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.
  • Strong experience with Facebook Pixel and Conversions API.
  • Solid JavaScript knowledge for tracking implementations.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

title: Arquiteto de nuvem
description:
O Cloud Architect será responsável por conduzir avaliações técnicas, definir estratégias de migração, criar arquiteturas alvo e liderar a execução do plano proposto. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo alinhamento com padrões de arquitetura, governança e boas práticas da AWS.


Responsabilidades Principais:

-Realizar assessment dos ambientes atuais (discovery, análise de workloads, recomendações).

-Elaborar diagramas de arquitetura, planos de migração e cronogramas detalhados.

-Definir estratégias de migração considerando segurança, performance e custo.

-Apoiar na execução do plano de migração (delivery), garantindo aderência às recomendações.

-Utilizar ferramentas de apoio à migração (ex.: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, entre outras).

-Implementar práticas de monitoramento e otimização de performance pós-migração.

-Garantir conformidade com boas práticas da AWS e padrões corporativos.

-Interagir com stakeholders e apresentar relatórios técnicos.


Competências Técnicas:

-Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS Cloud (assessment e delivery).

-Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de soluções AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).

-Familiaridade com ambientes on-premises (virtualização, redes, storage).

-Domínio de ferramentas de migração e discovery (ex: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, AWS Application Migration Service).

-Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de performance (CloudWatch, Dynatrace, etc.).

-Capacidade de criar diagramas técnicos (Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart).

-Inglês fluente.


Perfil comportamental:

-Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica.

-Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma.

-Comunicação clara e habilidade para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

-Orientação para resultados e foco em qualidade.

-Flexibilidade para lidar com ambientes complexos e mudanças de escopo.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking


Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.


In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.


Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.


Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.


What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.


How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:


Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Data Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position and is a PJ contract.


Required Skills & Experience


- 5+ years of experience with Power BI development and engineering (DAX and semantic model development and deployment)

- Strong hands on coding ability in PySpark and Python

- Professional working experience with Databricks and Spark platforms

- Experience working in Microsoft Fabric

- Fair knowledge on the use of Azure Dev Ops (ADO) to manage repository and versions

- Strong communication skills and experience engaging directly with business stakeholders and technical teams


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


- Knowledge of Tabular and ALM tools to work on Semantic Model and automation

- Experience working for a global company/ with a global team


Job Description


A global biopharmaceutical company is seeking strong Data Engineers to join their team to support a portfolio of ongoing clinical operations projects. These individuals will work on a team of Engineers of all levels and will partner with technical and functional partners to meet the project needs. The ideal candidates should and in-depth expertise with Power BI (including DAX and Semantic Model Development), strong PySpark & Python coding experience, and experience with Databricks. Additionally, all senior level resources should have proven working experience with and strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and should have experience with leading junior team members. Strong communication skills are a must along with the proven ability to work with cross functional teams and stakeholders to drive project work and all candidates should be eager to learn new skills. These are immediate, ongoing needs that will go until the end of 2026 and will be extended into 2027. These positions are based in LATAM and candidates are able to sit remotely in any country with similar timezone to US EST.

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions
